az network nsg rule create \
    --resource-group TestLabRG \
    --nsg-name LAN2-nsg \
    --name toInfoblox-22 \
    --priority 100 \
    --direction Inbound \
    --access Allow \
    --protocol Tcp \
    --source-address-prefixes '*' \
    --source-port-ranges '*' \
    --destination-address-prefixes '10.239.40.0/24' \
    --destination-port-ranges 22 \
    --description "Allow inbound traffic on Infoblox for SSH access"

              uses: actions/checkout@v4

              with:
                  client-id: ${{ secrets.AZURE_CLIENT_ID }}
                  tenant-id: ${{ secrets.AZURE_TENANT_ID }}
                  subscription-id: ${{ secrets.AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID }}

            - name: Login to Azure (Dry Run)
              run: |
                az account show




  BICEP_FILE: ${{ github.workspace }}/.github/bicep/main.bicep
  PARAMETERS_FILE: ${{ github.workspace }}/.github/bicep/parameters/vmdef.json


      - name: Deploy Bicep templates
        uses: azure/arm-deploy@v2
        with:
          scope: resourcegroup
          subscriptionId: ${{ secrets.AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID }}
          resourceGroupName: ${{ env.RESOURCE_GROUP }}
          template: ${{ env.BICEP_FILE }}
          parameters: ${{ env.PARAMETERS_FILE }}
          deploymentName: vm-deployment-${{ github.run_number }}

          commit caaa313da2789a10b9f894a0151ae7b76a2a8c7f



          nsg.bicep - vmConfigs

          @description('Name of - Network Security Group')
param nsgName string

@description('Location of NSG')
param location string = resourceGroup().location

@description('Allow SSH port (TCP-22)')
param allowSSH bool = true

@description('Allow HTTPS (TCP-443)')
param allowHTTPS bool = true

@description('Allowed Source for SSH/HTTPs')
param sshSourceIP string = '*'

resource nsg 'Microsoft.Network/networkSecurityGroups@2024-10-01' = {
  name: nsgName
  location: location
  properties: {
    securityRules: [
      {
        name: 'Allow-SSH-Infoblox'
        properties: {
          priority: 100
          protocol: 'Tcp'
          access: allowSSH ? 'Allow' : 'Deny'
          direction: 'Inbound'
          sourceAddressPrefix: sshSourceIP
          sourcePortRange: '*'
          destinationAddressPrefixes: [
            '10.239.40.0/24'
            '10.240.40.0/24'
          ]
          destinationPortRange: '22'
        }
      }
      {
        name: 'Allow-HTTPs-Infoblox'
        properties: {
          priority: 110
          protocol: 'Tcp'
          access: allowHTTPS ? 'Allow' : 'Deny'
          direction: 'Inbound'
          sourceAddressPrefix: sshSourceIP
          sourcePortRange: '*'
          destinationAddressPrefixes: [
            '10.239.40.0/24'
            '10.240.40.0/24'
          ]
          destinationPortRange: '443'
        }
      }
    ]
  }
}

output nsgId string = nsg.id
output nsgName string = nsg.name

Bicep valiation----------

validate:
    name: Validate Bicep Templates
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Azure Login
        uses: azure/login@v2
        with:
          client-id: ${{ secrets.AZURE_CLIENT_ID }}
          tenant-id: ${{ secrets.AZURE_TENANT_ID }}
          subscription-id: ${{ secrets.AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID }}

      - name: Validate Bicep - South India
        uses: azure/cli@v2
        with:
          inlineScript: |
            az deployment group validate \
              --resource-group ${{env.RESOURCE_GROUP}} \
              --template-file ${{env.BICEP_FILE}} \
              --parameters ${{env.PARAM_FILE}}

  contents: read

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v2
      - name: Validating yaml files
        run: yamllint .
